summary: Optional native WhatsApp read+typing before a new ordinary GENERAL turn, after current server-issued linked authority. LIVE only, exact inbox/binding/recipient/lease, valid inbound WAMID and unexpired customer window. One best-effort request, 1.5 second abort budget; failure cannot block the reply. This new method explicitly uses Graph v25 separately from all unchanged v21 OTP/outbound sends. No refresh loop, schema, environment, provider-setting, worker, permission or canonical command change. Source and fake-network checks are not live WhatsApp acceptance.

capabilities.note: Transient authenticated channel UX only; existing model/domain tools, exact review, confirmation, current scope and product command remain unchanged.

docs.note: Coordinator records native typing placement/protocol and separately gated live acceptance in Brain/Workshop/mobile mirror.
No inbound HTTP/tRPC contract change. Communications has an optional server-only provider method; Graph v25 read+typing is isolated from existing v21 sends.
Existing private linked identity, LIVE classification, current grant/Store and rollout remain mandatory. QA/control/OTP/workflow/recovered turns do not trigger typing.
No domain capability, tool, confirmation or rollout enrollment change.
No schema or durable job/outbox contracts change; typing is nonpersistent optional provider UX.

evidence.result: Two new fake-network provider cases plus two authenticated guard/failure cases in channel-typing.test.ts passed 4 tests / 35 assertions. Exact read+typing payload, separate v25 endpoint, existing text v21, no redirects, abort signal, invalid source no HTTP, generic error, LIVE/current lease/enrollment eligibility, QA/control/workflow/stale rejection and failure continuation. No actual provider or DB calls.

Thin optional hook is after current linked context and usable ordinary input, before new GENERAL turn. Earlier deterministic ACTION/control and recovered-run returns exclude typing. Midday runtime.ts uses best-effort thread.startTyping after linked user resolution. Native protocol checked against Meta-owned Postman Send typing indicator and read receipt collection; direct Meta documentation 429, current first-party Chat SDK docs/source establish v25 default and 25-second native lifetime. Actual Meta/client acceptance remains pending release.
